problemStatement.plain: Formalizes modular reduction via the minimal polynomial in general K-algebras: evaluating f at x equals evaluating f mod minpoly(x). Also proves base change behavior in algebra towers K ⊂ L ⊂ A, showing degree can only decrease when extending the base field.
